'''Aur X''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Aur system/Legends|Aur system]]<ref name="EGtW:AC" /> near the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Phu/Legends|Phu]]. The planet occupied the tenth orbital position within its [[Star system/Legends|star system]] and consisted of a giant [[Diamond/Legends|diamond]] the size of a terrestrial world. It was believed that Aur X, as well as [[Aur IX]] another diamond planet in the same system, were originally the cores of [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]]. Along with the [[Aur system diamond cloud|cloud of diamond fragments]] that occupied the eleventh orbital position in the Aur system, the planets were collectively known as the [[Aur Diamonds]], and thought to have been creations of the ancient [[Celestial/Legends|Celestial]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="EGtW:AC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Aur X was originally meant to be mentioned in the [[2012]] source book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]], however the sidebar that would have mentioned the system was cut before the book's release. The information regarding the planet was then released in [[2013]] as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut]]'', a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Jason Fry and [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from the ''Essential Guide to Warfare''.
